scope: Factorize prior over continuous prefix positions; same authored corpus and reserved fresh image exclusions
hypothesis: Whole-prefix flow underfits coherent sequences; causal next-vector supervision provides many more local transitions
backbones: Frozen, cached teacher prefix/text vectors only during reader training
representation: Training-only token PCA, smallest rank from64,128,192,256,320,384,512,768,1024 with training raw MSE <=1e-7; latent std clamped0.1
reader: Two-layer causal GRU256, context-conditioned continuous next-vector rectified flow width512, numeric EOS head; no runtime text vocabulary or lookup
objective: Valid-position velocity MSE +0.2 EOS BCE; shifted gold previous continuous prefix vectors, Gaussian previous-vector noise0.02 in training
sampling: Causal generated previous vectors;64 Euler steps per vector; fixed Gaussian seed42; EOS threshold0.5, min1 max32 prefix vectors
flow_skip: Known isotropic Gaussian bridge velocity coefficient (2t-1)/(t^2+(1-t)^2) times state, plus learned residual
controls: Same prespecified training/held text-feature controls and exposed image plan; exact-token-subspace and gold-history diagnostic controls kept separate
acceptance: Actual audio and human listening; ASR auxiliary only; no fresh data access or automatic quality claims
